body:
On a Windows restart, the OS kills the shells inside Warp. Each shell exit (Event::Exited in app/src/pane_group/pane/terminal_pane.rs) closes its pane and tab, and each tab close rewrites the single session snapshot (save_app -> save_app_state), so the next launch restores 1 tab or few instead of all. A deliberate quit or a hard kill keeps the snapshot.

Fix (pattern: upstream warpdotdev/warp PR 15990, closed unmerged for process reasons):
1. app/src/system/shutdown.rs: is_session_ending() = latched flag (macOS system-terminate) || GetSystemMetrics(SM_SHUTTINGDOWN) on Windows. Gate the Event::Exited pane close on it.
2. Windows startup: SetProcessShutdownParameters(0x3FF, 0) beside check_redirection_guard in app/src/platform/windows.rs so Windows asks Warp to end before default-level console processes.
3. save_app returns early while is_session_ending(), so no shutdown-time save (window move/focus/close etc.) can shrink the snapshot.
Out of scope: WM_QUERYENDSESSION hook / winit fork change, periodic saves, deferred process-exit saves.

body:
Bring Synth Warp's legal surface in line with AGPL-3.0-only/MIT and Warp's trademark position (same review done for Synth Zed).
- Add legal/synth-warp-notice.md: licenses (AGPL-3.0-only app, MIT warpui/warpui_core), source location, third-party notices, no warranty, non-affiliation, online services.
- README: fix self-referential upstream link; add attribution/non-affiliation line and trademark note.
- OSS UI must not say "By continuing, you agree to Warp's Terms of Service" (login_slide.rs, auth_view_body.rs): gate on warp_inc_links_enabled(). Privacy page link text must not say "Warp's privacy policy" when it points at the fork's page.
- Windows installer (oss channel): publisher/URL = Synth Warp contributors / github.com/synthet/warp instead of Denver Technologies / warp.dev.
- Exe version resource + macOS plist copyright: keep Denver Technologies' copyright alongside the fork's.
- Linux package templates: License field must name AGPL-3.0-only AND MIT, not warp.dev/terms-of-service; Vendor/URL to the fork.
Out of scope (separate tickets, need decisions): logo replacement, product rename, Windows install identity/overlay.

body:
script/windows/deploy.ps1 overlays the fork onto the official install at <path> (kills official warp.exe, reuses Warp's uninstaller and shortcuts, rewrites Warp's Explorer context menu to warposs://). Do what Synth Zed did: install into its own per-user folder, %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\SynthWarp, side by side with official Warp, without touching the official install, its processes or registry.
- Stop only processes running from the Synth Warp folder; no elevation.
- Own Start menu shortcut ("Synth Warp"), own CLI shims, own HKCU Explorer "Open Synth Warp" entries using warposs://.
- User data already lives under io.github.synthet.Warp, so no migration.
- Update docs/guides/windows-local-deploy.md and script/windows/README.md.

body: On Windows the fork installs PowerShell hooks (scripts/claude-warp-hooks) whose on-session-start.ps1 reports plugin_version 2.2.0, below MINIMUM_PLUGIN_VERSION 2.4.0 (raised by an upstream sync). The agent footer then always shows "Plugin update instructions", whose fix (re-run the installer) cannot clear it because the installed hooks already match the repo. ClaudePluginManager::needs_update() already returns false on Windows; supports_update() should too, so the version-based chip does not apply to the hook port.
title: Windows: stop the permanent Claude "update plugin" chip for the PowerShell hooks

acceptance.text: WHEN the OSS build runs without SYNTH_WARP_SERVER_ROOT_URL THEN Settings → Agents → Agent → Custom Inference shows no "Warp credits" or "Warp's servers" text and explains that keys are only used by a self-hosted backend.
WHEN no backend is configured THEN the provider key fields are disabled with a one-line prerequisite, and enabled when `ChannelState::warp_cloud_enabled()` is true.

WHEN the OSS build is exercised (startup, idle 10 min, settings walk, workflows, session restore, SSH, indexing toggle, agent toggle) THEN no connection to *.warp.dev or any host other than user-configured ones is observed, and any exception is filed as a ticket.

WHEN the OSS build runs THEN Settings → Keyboard shortcuts and the Keyboard Shortcuts panel list none of: Left Panel: Warp Drive, Toggle Warp Drive, Toggle Team Workflows Modal, Share Pane, Share Selected Block, Slash command: /connect-grok, Accept Prompt Suggestion, Open AI Command Suggestions.
WHEN Accept Prompt Suggestion is hidden from listings THEN the code-diff accept keystroke lookup (code_diff_view.rs get_binding_by_name) still resolves.

WHEN the Agent Management View has no local function in OSS THEN its binding (Ctrl+Shift+M) is gated on `ChannelState::cloud_agents_enabled()`; otherwise the finding is documented and the binding works.

WHEN SYNTH_WARP_REMOTE_CONTROL_URL is unset THEN no "Share session" entry appears in the tab, pane, terminal, block, input or alt-screen menus, the command palette, slash commands, inline banners or the Features "Confirm before closing shared session" row.
WHEN SYNTH_WARP_REMOTE_CONTROL_URL is set to a valid non-warp.dev URL THEN those entries appear and sharing uses the self-hosted server, never a Warp login prompt.
WHEN the OSS build updates workspace settings THEN `update_session_sharing_enablement` cannot turn `CreatingSharedSessions` on without a configured remote-control URL.

WHEN no backend is configured THEN Agent Profiles (base model aliases), MCP servers, codebase-indexing context widgets and the tools-panel Agent conversations tab show a prerequisite message instead of inert controls, for each surface verified to serve only the built-in agent.
WHEN the MCP servers page lists servers detected from Claude/Codex configs THEN it states whether they are read-only, and editing them never writes the external agent's config.
WHEN `autoupdate_config` is None THEN Check for Updates, Install Update and Relaunch, Features "Show changelog toast after updates", Agent "Show Warp Agent changelog…" and /changelog are hidden.

WHEN Voice input is unavailable (`!warp_hosted_ai_enabled()`) THEN the CLI-agent toolbar configurator offers no Voice Input chip, saved layouts drop it on load, and Restore default produces only supported chips.

WHEN the OSS build runs THEN the Workflows modal shows no Team Workflows category, the bundled catalog and Repository workflows remain, and the Features workflow info link goes through `warp_inc_links_enabled()`.
WHEN cloud-surface-audit.md and local-first.md are read THEN they state that global workflows are a bundled offline catalog and that sharing requires a configured remote-control server.

WHEN nextest runs THEN an OSS exposure test enumerates editable binding names and visible settings sections and fails if any belongs to a denylisted unavailable capability (Drive, team, updater, sharing without server, Oz, SuperGrok, voice).

WHEN the settings information architecture is revised THEN a spec exists that makes CLI Agents first-class, groups the built-in agent as one optional section, and covers the reviewer's mockups and capability (supported/configured/can-execute) model.
WHEN About shows the version THEN its source is documented and consistent with the release branch (0.1.0 vs chore/release-v0.3.0 explained or fixed).
